stories.title: Blackstone, Warburg explore IntraFi sale above $10 billion, sources say
stories.summary: Blackstone and Warburg Pincus are exploring a sale of IntraFi at a price above $10 billion, Investing.com reported, citing sources. IntraFi runs a deposit-placement network used by banks. No buyer or timeline was named.
stories.whyItMatters: A deal this size would mark one of the larger financial-services buyouts of the year and signal private equity appetite for deposit infrastructure.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of a sale process or buyer.
Any formal statement from Blackstone, Warburg, or IntraFi.
questions: Why are the owners selling now?

stories.title: Samsung, SK Hynix said to upgrade China plants for advanced chips
stories.summary: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading their China-based plants to produce more advanced chips, Investing.com reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The report did not specify chip types or a timeline.
stories.whyItMatters: The move touches the tension between U.S. export controls on advanced chips and the two firms' large China manufacturing footprint.
whatToWatch: Any U.S. regulatory response to the upgrades.
Official comment from Samsung or SK Hynix.
questions: Do the upgrades need U.S. export licenses?
